meta.name: The Last of Us
meta.description: Veinte años después de la destrucción de la civilización moderna, Joel, un aguerrido superviviente, es contratado para sacar a Ellie, una joven de 14 años, de una opresiva zona de cuarentena. Lo que empieza como un trabajo sencillo pronto se convierte en un viaje brutal y desgarrador, ya que ambos deben atravesar Estados Unidos y depender el uno del otro para sobrevivir.

videos.title: Cuando Estés Perdido en la Oscuridad
videos.overview: Veinte años después de que un brote de hongos azote el planeta, a los sobrevivientes Joel y Tess les es asignada una misión que podría cambiarlo todo.

videos.title: Infectados
videos.overview: Luego de escapar de la zona de cuarentena, Joel y Tess discuten sobre el destino de Ellie mientras transitan las ruinas de un Boston abandonada ya hace mucho tiempo.

videos.title: Mucho, Mucho tiempo
videos.overview: Cuando un extraño se acerca al recinto de Bill, un aficionado en preparativos para escenarios apocalípticos, ambos forjan una conexión poco probable. Más tarde, Joel y Ellie buscan la guía de Bill.

videos.title: Por Favor, Toma mi Mano
videos.overview: Después de abandonar su camioneta en Kansas City, Joel y Ellie intentan escapar sin llamar la atención de una vengativa líder rebelde.

videos.title: Resistir y Sobrevivir
videos.overview: Mientras intentan evadir a los rebeldes, Joel y Ellie se cruzan con el hombre más buscado de Kansas City. Kathleen continúa su persecución.

videos.title: Parentesco
videos.overview: Tras ignorar los consejos de los lugareños, Joel y Ellie se adentran en territorio peligroso en busca de las Luciérnagas… y de Tommy.

videos.title: Lo que Dejamos Atrás
videos.overview: Mientras Joel lucha por sobrevivir, Ellie recuerda la noche que lo cambió todo.

videos.title: Cuando Más Necesitamos
videos.overview: Ellie se topa con un vengativo grupo de supervivientes y llama la atención de su líder. Un debilitado Joel se enfrenta a una nueva amenaza.

videos.title: Busca la luz
videos.overview: Una Anna embarazada deposita su confianza en una amiga de toda la vida. Más tarde, Joel y Ellie se acercan al final de su viaje.

videos.title: Días Futuros
videos.overview: Cinco años después, Joel y Ellie se ven envueltos en un conflicto en un mundo aún más peligroso e impredecible que el que dejaron atrás.

videos.title: A Través del Valle
videos.overview: Mientras Abby sopesa sus opciones, Jackson Hole se prepara para una tormenta en medio de crecientes avistamientos de Infectados.

videos.title: El Camino
videos.overview: Tras la información de Diana, Ellie prepara una petición al consejo del pueblo. Cerca de Seattle, un grupo religioso huye de una guerra.

videos.title: Día Uno
videos.overview: En 2018, la FEDRA de Seattle se enfrenta a un enemigo inesperado. Diez años después, Ellie y Dina se encuentran en medio de una sangrienta batalla entre los fervientes serafitas y una despiadada milicia.

videos.title: Siente Su Amor
videos.overview: El WLF hace un descubrimiento peligroso... con un alto precio. Más tarde, Ellie deberá decidir si continúa con su plan —y arriesgarse a poner en peligro a Dina— o si abandona su búsqueda de justicia.

videos.title: El Precio
videos.overview: Joel sorprende a Ellie por su cumpleaños. A medida que su distanciamiento se profundiza, Ellie se prepara para una confrontación, mientras que Joel toma una decisión difícil durante la patrulla.

videos.title: Convergencia
videos.overview: Mientras los Lobos y los Cicatrices se preparan para una batalla que podría poner fin a su larga disputa, la búsqueda de Ellie la aleja de sus amigos y la lleva a una confrontación devastadora.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E1
videos.overview: Series stars Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey, executive producers Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann, and more detail the emotionally charged beginnings of the end of modern civilization in The Last of Us.

videos.title: Episode 1 - “When You’re Lost in the Darkness” | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker talks with The Last of Us Showrunners – writer/director Craig Mazin and the creator of The Last of Us video game Neil Druckmann – about how they brought this new HBO Original series to life. Troy, Craig and Neil talk through Episode 1 of the series, unpacking key scenes and the overarching themes.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E2
videos.overview: The Clickers have arrived. Series executive producers Craig Mazin, Neil Druckmann and more discuss the first encounter between Joel (Pedro Pascal), Ellie (Bella Ramsey) Tess (Anna Torv) and Clickers.

videos.title: Episode 2 - “Infected” | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker talks with Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann who reveal that Episode 2 of the series is about the infected. They discuss why it was important for the actors (namely Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey) to not play the video game and they share a key scene from Tess’s backstory that was written but never shot.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E3
videos.overview: Meet Bill (Nick Offerman) and Frank (Murray Bartlett) and learn all about how their story deviated — and expanded — when translating the game to screen from the cast and executive producers Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann.

videos.title: Episode 3 - “Long, Long Time” | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann talk about the departure the series took into the story of Bill and Frank. Craig and Neil also reveal the thinking behind the casting Nick Offerman and Murray Bartlett to portray this middle-aged love and reveal an easter egg reference to the game that shows up at the end of the episode.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E4
videos.overview: Series stars and executive producers Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann break down Joel (Pedro Pascal) and Ellie’s (Bella Ramsey) journey into Kansas City and the addition of new characters Kathleen (Melanie Lynskey) and Perry (Jeffrey Pierce).

videos.title: Episode 4 - “Please Hold to My Hand” | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann walk through Episode 4, exploring key developments in Ellie and Joel's relationship. They discuss a major antagonist of the show and tease Joel's dark past.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E5
videos.overview: Learn how the fates of Kathleen (Melanie Lynskey), Henry (Lamar Johnson) and Sam (Keivonn Woodard) impact Joel (Pedro Pascal) and Ellie (Bella Ramsey) on their journey for a cure. Plus, hear how the massive Infected scene was brought to life.

videos.title: Episode 5 - “Endure and Survive” | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann unpack Episode 5. They talk about why they made Sam deaf in the show, a departure from the game, and how they cast the role. In discussing the stories of Sam and Henry, Neil and Craig continue to dig into the theme of parental love. Also, Neil gives a 101 on the various Infected you see on screen–Bloaters and all.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E6
videos.overview: Series stars Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey break down the growing bond between Joel and Ellie, plus find out about the big reunion in Wyoming and how the show transformed a town.

videos.title: Episode 6 - "Kin" | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann unpack the emotional crossroads inside Episode 6. Neil reveals what key aspects of Joel and Ellie came from the actors who played them in the game and shares an Easter egg from Craig’s life that they put in this episode. Finally, they talk about how director Jasmila Žbanić brought the community of Jackson to life, and how carefully they adapted a beloved argument between Joel and Ellie  from the game.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E7
videos.overview: Bella Ramsey, Storm Reid and more detail the adventure Ellie and Riley have in the mall and reveal its lasting impact on Ellie’s journey.

videos.title: Episode 7 - "Left Behind" | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann break down the Ellie and Riley relationship and tease the backstory of Ellie's scar. They geek out over arcades, malls and Mortal Kombat II and share how they brought all those sights and sounds to life on screen.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E8
videos.overview: Learn how a pivotal moment in Joel and Ellie’s journey came to life, with insight and new details from Bella Ramsey, Pedro Pascal, Craig Mazin, Neil Druckmann and more.

videos.title: Episode 8 - "When We Are in Need" | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and Showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann unpack the episode in which Troy has an on-screen role. They break down the character of David and how this narcissistic predator tries to manipulate Ellie. They discuss one of the darkest moments of the show so far, and Neil says why it was so important to a subvert typical narrative.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E9
videos.overview: Pedro Pascal, Bella Ramsey and more reveal the emotional reunions and high stakes at the core of the season finale, plus find out how Joel’s big decision impacts the world around him.

videos.title: Episode 9 - "Look for the Light" | The Last of Us Podcast
videos.overview: Host Troy Baker and showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann are joined by special guest Ashley Johnson, who played Ellie in the game and plays a pivotal character in the finale episode of the season. The group unpacks the origin of Ellie's immunity and the story of Joel's scar. They also debate the morality of Joel's decisions at the end of the show and what his actions do to his relationship with Ellie.
